overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Board's brief April 19 howitzer discussion was in open session and was not a deliberation outside a noticed meeting. The notice-specificity claim was untimely and not reviewed.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Board discussed the howitzer installation at a veterans memorial outside of a noticed meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Board did not discuss the issue of the howitzer outside of a noticed meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the April 19 notice listing a 'Veterans Memorial Committee Liaison Report' was not specific enough about its topic.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we do not consider any allegations concerning the April 19 meeting notice.
